title: Gamla bron, Umeå
visualBrief: Ten shallow polygonal bowstring steel-truss spans above a narrow pedestrian deck, carried on open X-braced steel trestles and coursed masonry piers; riveted structural flanges, deck joists, three-bar parapets, the visible utility main, pole line and low lighting fittings.

sourceFacts.identity: Wikidata Q3603782, Umeå, Sweden; not another similarly named old bridge.

nominalLengthMeters.basis: Broar i Västerbottens län, page 33; also the lighting contractor project description.

spanCount.basis: Broar i Västerbottens län, page 33; the municipality also describes ten illuminated arch pairs in its 2022 release.

currentSteelSuperstructureDate.basis: Lighting contractor account and heritage bridge inventory.

mappedEnvelope.basis: OSM way/454463632, exact wikidata tag; map-derived envelope includes end treatment and is not a surveyed engineering width.

sourceFacts.observedConstruction: 2023 original photograph by Axel Pettersson and 2022 municipality photograph show bowed upper truss chords, steel trestles above masonry, riveted/bolted gussets, large pipe below the deck, utility poles and a wire.

reconstructedDimensions.basis: Photo-proportioned visual reconstruction, not measured sections. Equal 30.1 m span division follows the published 301 m total; individual pier stations, vertical grade and member sizes need drawings or survey.

nativeAxes.transverse: +Z east-southeast downstream, carrying the large pipe and utility poles
nativeAxes.origin: Horizontal midpoint of the nominal 301 m span system; Y=0 is the reconstructed exposed pier foot. The host terrain at the mapped south landing attaches to model deck Y=5.8 through terrainReference, not a surveyed river stage.

geographicProposal.groundContactBasis: The south mapped cycleway endpoint terrain attaches to the authored deck at Y=5.8. This clears the coarse high bank without altering native elevation. The north connection uses a short supported grade blend. Exposed masonry and seasonal river stage remain approximate.
geographicProposal.notes: Confirmed NNE crossing and ESE downstream pipe/pole side. Nominal 301 m superstructure and full 309 m extent remain separate. Replace the former buried sea-level-zero placement with host terrain referenced to the south mapped deck landing at model Y=5.8. Clip only the overlapping cycleway and its connected end fragments. Preserve all buildings, unrelated road geometry, native water and original DEM. Equal span stationing, pier heights, river stage and exact bank grading remain reconstructed.

terrainReference.basis: South mapped cycleway landing terrain attaches to the authored deck at Y=5.8. The higher bank establishes a stable host-relative bridge level; not surveyed river stage.

limitations: The nominal 301 m superstructure, 309 m mapped extent and ten equal reconstructed spans remain distinct; individual pier stationing, dimensions and fittings are photo-proportioned.
The source master represents the observed 2023 exterior. No surveyed river stage, submerged foundations, interior or current construction state is claimed.
The native south landing establishes the host-relative deck height; the north connection is an approximate supported grade blend. Original coarse terrain and water are retained.
Tiny fasteners, individual stone relief and pole wires are omitted from lower LODs; full details remain in the preserved master. Physical phone/laptop timings remain pending.
geometrySource: Original deterministic Molen mesh from documented identity, published overall length and span count, plus separately labeled photographic reconstruction. No third-party mesh or image is embedded.

importReason: Whole-bridge position quantization at 309 m extent can erase small steel flanges, rail bars, bolt heads and masonry joints. Preserve the authored source until measured LODs are available.
